digest.component_or_area: mutation testing gate and CI workflow
propositions: Historical whole-file mutation counts in signing.py (491 mutants) are stale; a mutmut 3.7.0 baseline now reports 814 mutants including real contract gaps and equivalent survivors that cannot be bulk-fingerprinted.

Mutation shard enforcement must transition from stale ceilings through three phased modes (advisory, ratchet, strict) with explicit per-shard promotion criteria: ratchet requires three stable base/head pilot runs under 24 minutes; strict requires no unfingerpinted survivors or timeouts.

Fresh isolated base/head archives replace cached mutation verdicts; ratchet preserves AST-identical legacy survivors but blocks killed regressions; strict applies changed-function rules to entire shards.

Selector maps changed source, test, support files, and global config changes to shards; selection preserves renames/deletions, reports unmatched Python tests, fails unresolved refs, and emits explicit empty-selection state.
Manifest pinning timeout_constant=1.0 and timeout_multiplier=15.0 derives per-mutant wall limits; workflow caps each shard job at 30 minutes; diagnostic reruns cannot turn red green.
